sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This policy applies to Global NovaTech staff and authorized stakeholders. Approved AI Tools is maintained by IT Operations.

sections.heading: Policy requirement
sections.text: Public AI tools must not receive customer PII; new SaaS requires Security and Finance review.

sections.heading: Implementation steps
sections.text: 1. Log the request, business purpose, owner, and applicable region. 2. Verify the current policy version and eligibility. 3. Obtain the designated approval before execution. 4. Record the outcome and evidence in the department tracking system. 5. Escalate exceptions to IT Operations.

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.text: A staff member asks about approved ai tools. The reviewer checks the rule above, validates employee scope, records approvals, and follows the related procedure in LEGAL-002. Do not use superseded guidance for current requests.

sections.heading: Controls and exceptions
sections.text: Exceptions need written approval from IT Operations. Confidential or Restricted material must only be retrieved for entitled roles. The owning team reviews the policy annually.

sections.heading: Cross-department handoff
sections.text: For overlapping questions, consult LEGAL-002. If policies disagree, use the active version effective on the relevant date and escalate unresolved conflicts to the owners.
